peers.name: grilling
peers.description: Grill the user relentlessly about a plan, decision, or idea. Use when the user wants to stress-test their thinking, or uses any 'grill' trigger phrases.

peers.name: grill-with-docs
peers.description: A relentless interview to sharpen a plan or design, which also creates docs (ADR's and glossary) as we go.

peers.name: improve-codebase-architecture
peers.description: Scan a codebase for deepening opportunities, present them as a visual HTML report, then grill through whichever one you pick.

peers.name: tdd
peers.description: Test-driven development. Use when the user wants to build features or fix bugs test-first, mentions "red-green-refactor", or wants integration tests.

en.tagline: Interview to sharpen a plan or design
en.summary: grill-me is a skill that runs a relentless interview on a plan or design. Its SKILL.md is short. It hands the work to a separate skill named "grilling", so the details of the interview are defined there, not in this file.
problem: A plan or design can look finished while it still has weak points. Those points often stay hidden until someone questions them.
With grill-me, you ask for a relentless interview on your plan or design. The questioning is handled by the "grilling" skill, so your plan gets tested before you commit to it.
fit: Checking a design before you start building it
Stress-testing a plan that has not been reviewed by anyone else
Preparing for a review by having your plan questioned first
unfit: Cases where you want the model to start questioning on its own, since the skill is not auto-invoked
Cases where you need a finished document or code rather than questions
steps: You invoke grill-me yourself, because it is set so the model does not start it automatically.
The skill calls the Skill tool with "grilling".
The grilling skill runs the interview on your plan or design.

zh.tagline: 通过追问打磨计划或设计
zh.summary: grill-me 是一个对计划或设计进行连续追问的技能。它的 SKILL.md 很短，实际工作交给名为 "grilling" 的另一个技能完成，所以追问的具体方式不在这个文件里定义。
problem: 计划或设计看起来可能已经完整，但仍有薄弱之处。这些问题往往要等有人追问才会暴露。
使用 grill-me 时，你请求对计划或设计进行连续追问。提问由 "grilling" 技能负责，因此计划在你投入执行前会先接受检验。
fit: 在开始构建前检查设计
对尚未经他人审阅的计划做压力测试
在正式评审前，先让计划接受追问
unfit: 希望模型自行发起追问的场景，因为该技能不会被自动调用
需要的是成品文档或代码，而不是问题的场景
steps: 由你自己调用 grill-me，因为它被设置为不会由模型自动启动。
该技能调用 Skill 工具，并传入 "grilling"。
grilling 技能对你的计划或设计进行追问。
